summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K on 25 September 2026 announcing completion of its GBP 1.75bn share buyback programme, originally announced 30 January 2026 and managed by Goldman Sachs International. Between 30 January and 24 September 2026, the company repurchased 1,712,662,647 ordinary shares for aggregate consideration of GBP 1.75bn, with the final purchase made 24 September 2026. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation is disclosed. The programme was executed in accordance with its terms; no regulatory clock or ownership split is noted. Watch for the next capital return announcement and any incremental buyback tranche alongside quarterly results.
